project_summary: Trusted single-user official norns/grid emulator, Ubuntu20.04 WSL2 with Windows browser automation. Audio/device support and optional official Maiden are reviewed and merged through7d56cf0. Mosaic remains external and optional. H03 improves the existing browser PCM route; Docker remains queued.
diff_intent: Review H03 from7d56cf0: separate monitor lifetime/read locking from slow native actions; opt-in listening interval identities with legacy API compatibility; browser stale asynchronous completion guards; measured prefill/poll tuning; HTTP persistent connections and TCP_NODELAY to reduce polling connection churn. Generic real-engine tests cover slow callbacks, actual renderer onset/continuity, stale operations/reconnect, cleanup and existing transport regressions. Failed tuning experiments remain evidence, not silently waived.
focus: Find actionable in-scope concurrency, lifecycle, protocol-framing and false-green issues. Inspect H03.md and actual referenced reports. Check audio lock order and shutdown/disconnect, old read/start/stop behavior and browser startup cancellation, bounded queues and explicit errors, successful response lengths versus rejected unread request bodies with keepalive, honest latency boundaries/uncertainty and suitability. Do not infer physical speakers, all engines, arbitrary-duration reliability or platform support from browser tests. No financial/enterprise scope, hardware prerequisites or broad refactoring. Review evidence and implementation, not only documentation.
